answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via free-space optical challenges. Steerable verifier lasers send modulated nonces to registered bearings, requiring signed optical replies within tight deadlines and flagging identities sharing one beam footprint. Forging agents demands separate transceivers across unobstructed sites beyond the beam's divergence width. However, occlusion from a swaying juniper, mist over a jetty, or a passing falcon can sever links and lock out honest nodes.
